title: 송이 기준 품목별 가중평균 재고평가 비교

actions.name: READ_STEM_COST_COMPARISON
actions.sideEffect: Explicit authenticated SELECT-only comparison. User/year/week-scoped process-memory job, maximum 2 running and 180s timeout, bounded polling; no DB/filesystem job writes. Preserve ShipmentDetail Amount/Vat/isFix, ShipmentDate, ShipmentFarm, Estimate, Warehouse*, ProductStock, StockHistory, WebProfitReport and stored/confirmed snapshots. No refresh, DDL, SP or persistent cache writes. Ordinary saved report reads unchanged.

criteria.quantity: Actual historical SteamQuantity; no current Product conversion or fallback1. Stock OutUnit conversion only when historical same-product source ratio agrees. Only explicit ProductStock zero is a cost anchor; absent product row is unknown.
criteria.cost: Same ProdKey opening value plus exact WdetailKey landed amount divided by same-product stems; display price times OutQuantity is forbidden. Unknown positive adjustment acquisition cost blocks. Receipt landed amounts must reconcile G+H before publishing profit.
criteria.formula: New E/F from product stem WAC; existing C/G/H/I/J/K and category/total denominator formulas retained. Freight/customs not added twice. Missing category products or H/S inputs hold totals, never zero-fill.
criteria.display: Original bunch/box display preserved separately. New comparison and legacy stored Excel formula values explicitly named; existing output remains legacy reference.

crossYearFixture.description: 2025/2026 same week/product cannot mix; only actual same-year earlier zero anchor, future receipt excluded; missing evidence never1 or0.

dnspyEvidence.source: Actual dnSpy.Console.exe FormStockView.GetData and WarehouseDetail/ShipmentDetail saved quantity columns, SELECT-only unit evidence; no shared ledger writes.
